answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and prove Semaphore-tree membership before evaluating the epoch polynomial at a secret-derived identity point. A beacon fixes the epoch and rate-limit domain; repeated messages that violate the limit produce distinct Shamir shares, which let anyone reconstruct the identity secret and verify equivocation, not expose an arbitrary wallet key. The resulting proof triggers immediate collateral slashing; vertex and sonnet are merely labels, not security assumptions.
